import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = {
    "date": ["2024-01-01"] * 4 + ["2024-01-01"] * 1,

    "product": ["Cappuccino", "Cappuccino", "Tea", "Latte", "Americano"],

    "payment_method": ["Credit Card"] * 5,

}

plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
